home.faqTitle: Your questions about integrations and AI agents
home.ctaBody: Tell us which CRM and tools you use. We'll map the flows and send a fixed quote — built for small businesses, not enterprise theatre.

faqs.question: What does Promonet connect?
faqs.answer: We help small businesses connect the CRM they already use, such as Capsule, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Copper, or Insightly, to accounting, booking, and industry software. We also connect other business tools directly to each other; a CRM does not have to be involved.

faqs.question: Are you building us a new CRM?
faqs.answer: Our integration plans connect and support the CRM and tools you already use. You keep your existing software, and we build the connections so information moves between systems without repeated copying and pasting.

faqs.question: Can you connect a tool that is not listed on the site?
faqs.answer: Tell us which tool you use and what you want it to do. We check the available API or other integration options and confirm what is possible before quoting. Some tools have access restrictions or require a particular subscription plan.

faqs.question: Is Promonet for small businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with owners and small teams who want their existing tools connected or help finding AI agents to take on specific tasks. You can start with one connection or one AI role.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to connect tools?
faqs.answer: Monthly partnerships start at £600. Scale-up is £1,500 per month. A one-off connection starts at £1,000. Custom work is quoted separately.

faqs.question: How long does a typical integration take?
faqs.answer: After a get-to-know-you call and fixed quote, most integration builds take two to four weeks. Timing depends on the tools, access, and complexity of the work; we agree the scope and schedule before starting.

faqs.question: What support do we get after an integration goes live?
faqs.answer: Monthly partnerships include ongoing monitoring, alerts, and support for the agreed connections. A one-off project includes a documented handover, one follow-up task, and support to help you get comfortable with it. We agree any further maintenance separately.

faqs.question: Do I need developers on my team?
faqs.answer: No. We handle the technical work and explain the setup in plain English. You bring your knowledge of the business, the tools you use, and the tasks you want help with.

faqs.question: What is an independent AI agent?
faqs.answer: Think of an AI agent as a software teammate with a defined job. Depending on its capabilities and the access you give it, it can work through tasks, use connected tools, and report back. We help you choose suitable agents and give each one a clear brief, boundaries, and a way to check its work.

faqs.question: What tasks could an AI team take off my plate?
faqs.answer: Examples include planning social media, scheduling approved posts, finding new leads, researching prospects, drafting outreach and follow-ups, and turning your ideas into content. We start with repeatable tasks that have a clear outcome and are easy for you to review.

faqs.question: How do you decide which AI agents I need?
faqs.answer: We look at the jobs taking up your week and the people you would hire if budget were no constraint. Then we match suitable tasks to agent capabilities, your tools, and your budget. Start with one role and a small task, review the results, and expand when it is useful.

faqs.question: Can AI agents work independently, and do I stay in control?
faqs.answer: Agents can carry out agreed tasks independently where their tools and permissions allow. We define what they can do, when they should report back, and which actions need your approval, such as publishing posts or sending outreach. You review the results and can change the brief; AI output still needs human judgement.

faqs.question: Can AI agents work with my existing CRM and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. Agents with their own computers and browsers can use your existing CRM and tools through the same screens your team uses, even without an API or direct integration. We agree what information each agent can access and what actions it can take, then set it up and check the workflow in your tools.

faqs.question: How much does an AI-agent setup cost?
faqs.answer: We scope and quote AI-agent selection, setup, and any ongoing support around the roles and tasks you need. The integration prices above are for connecting business tools. We confirm our fee and any provider subscription or usage costs before you commit.

faqs.question: What access will an integration or AI agent need?
faqs.answer: It depends on the task. We agree which accounts and data are needed, use the permissions available in each tool to limit access to the job, and decide which actions require approval. We explain any access limitations before setup so you can decide what to connect.

faqs.question: What should I bring to the first conversation?
faqs.answer: A list of the tools you use, the jobs you repeat, and what you would most like off your plate. You do not need a technical specification or a chosen AI platform. We help turn that list into a practical first step and a clear quote.

about.title: Built by people who've lived the connectivity gap.
about.p1: We help small businesses connect CRM and industry tools at a low cost, with genuine human support — so owners stop re-typing data between systems.
about.p2: We're a small team of developers and designers. Over 20 years building some of the leading CRM solutions, we kept seeing the same thing: customers still struggling to connect their CRM to the rest of their tools — and their tools to each other, not just the CRM.
about.storyTitle: We saw a gap. Then we decided to fill it.
about.storyP1: Businesses buy great software, then spend Sunday nights copying data between systems that were never meant to talk. Agencies quote enterprise prices. Support becomes a ticket queue.
about.storyP2: Promonet exists to help small businesses fix that problem — at a low cost, with genuine human support.
about.stat1Body: Building CRM products and watching connectivity stay the unsolved part of the stack.
about.stat2Body: Fixed monthly partnerships or one-off builds — priced for small businesses, not enterprise RFPs.
about.stat3Body: Real people who know your tools. No account managers. No black-hole ticket queues.
about.ctaBody: Tell us which tools you're using. We'll help you connect them — simply, affordably, with humans on the other end.
